message: 強引に Be Going

name: Misa
message: 「Blah blah blah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yada yada yada.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rhubarb, rhubarb!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you guys even doing?」
Before I knew it, it had become a routine for everyone to come straight over to my place whenever our meetings dragged on.

name: Lolotte
message: 「--And that's what the Holy Night Festival is all about~♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I see~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, it seems that only students of Ryuusei Academy are allowed to enjoy the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh... Is that so...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I won't be able to enjoy it with Amyrina and Jiiya... It is truly unfortunate.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, about that... I was thinking maybe we could change it this year.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As expected of the Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. We all decided on it together, remember?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, that's right.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone helped us out so much at last month's KiraFes, so I wanted to return the favor even a little.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「How do you plan to do that?」

name: Synn
message: 「For this year's Holy Night Festival, I was thinking the students could take the lead and invite the residents of Ryuusei Town.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Oho~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which means both Jiiya and Amyrina will be able to enjoy it together with us!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do that, you'll be able to go past the school gates too. You two could even explore the place together, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The grounds inside Ryuusei Academy are super pretty and wonderful too~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, you can normally just walk right in on Sundays and stuff, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaaaah, that's riiiight!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh...? Could it be you weren't all that interested?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No, that's not it at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's plenty of interesting stuff at the academy. I think you'll have a pretty good time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes! You see, at the academy... there is a mysterious building called Finis Tower.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Finis... Tower?」

name: Synn
message: 「They say the layout changes every time you step inside, or that some princess is locked up at the top on the 60th floor.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whaat!? Doesn't it have 10,000 floors!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, those are just rumors-nobody's actually been inside--」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're talking about Finis Tower, I think my big sister's been inside before.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Though she said it was rough because you can't get a do-over or something.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think that makes it way more thrilling and fun, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, there is no reset button in life.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I see, I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, you see, there's talk of holding this year's Holy Night Festival around Finis Tower.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Is that so~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Every bit of it still has to be approved at the student general assembly, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Piece of cake!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah...\s04 Spending Christmas together with everyone... I'm already looking forward to it so, so much~~♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When will this 'Holy Night Festival' take place?」

name: Ria
message: 「December 24th. A grand opening to thunderous applause on Christmas Eve♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「December...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You only have to wait about one little month~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If it's then, Re-Crea will...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh!? N-No... It's already December, isn't it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you think you've got plenty of time, it flies right by once you start preparing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right... And I'm worried about the Demon's movements too...」

name: Ria
message: 「Things might get pretty tough from here on out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll give it my all if it's for something fun! Right, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「E-Eh, yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You won't be able to enjoy our wonderful happy life with that attitude! Come on, let's get fired up!! Yeah!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you angels.」

name: Lolotte & Amyrina
message: 「Fwaaah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't care if you get all excited, but don't forget what's really important.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What's this all of a sudden?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't just chase short-term gains and turn a blind eye to the problems right in front of you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What...!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm getting hungry.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, you're right!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And so, Synn-sama. Let's make some food.」

name: Synn
message: 「You say 'let's make,' but you're just going to watch, aren't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I'll lend a hand!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't go wasting food now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying, Mr. Panda!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That might happen if it were just me, but as long as I'm with the President, it'll be totally fine!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right, President?\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, get a room already. Hurry up and make it then. The great me is gonna play with Ria.」

name: Ria
message: 「Paa-chan, no. We're busy with the Holy Night Festival meeting right now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「*Whimper~* I'll be a good boy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Works out perfectly, doesn't it, Paqy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, let's get going. Come on, you too, Amyrina♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it really is curry rice after all!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hearing you put it like that kinda makes me want to change it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehhh~~ I didn't mean it sarcastically, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah, if I remember right, Nanaka's--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Curry rice sounds great, doesn't it, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I'm fine with anything...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want the President's curry riceeee--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Kyaa--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, stop fooling around. Don't worry. I kept the 'curry' part.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's curry rice, yet it's not curry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Its name is--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thanks for the food.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Curry udon, huh--clever move.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing clever about it, we just happened to have easy-to-get ingredients.」

name: Synn
message: 「I borrowed Nanaka's broth.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~ So it's the Treasurer's broth, is it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's my family's soba soup, isn't it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmmm~~. It's super delicious~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Geez, come on. Lolotte, you've got it all over your face.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngh, mmm~~」
I wipe Lolotte's mouth with a tissue.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. I just got carried away~」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle. Oh, Lolotte-chan, you're just like a baby.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A baby!? N-No, that's not it!! This is, well... u-ummm.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They say that when a man and a woman deepen their intimacy, a phenomenon can sometimes occur where one temporarily regresses into infancy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What kind of perverted play is that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is not perverted! Ours is a completely wholesome relationship!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh~~. So Synn-kun and Lolotte-chan got close enough for that before I knew it~~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I wonder about that?」

name: Ria
message: 「No, even if you ask me.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Being a lolicon is a crime, you know!?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, it's way too impure!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't treat someone like a little kid just because they regressed into infancy!! I'm only one grade below the two of you, after all!」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for the meal~~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Glad you enjoyed it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, Misa-chan. Let's clean up.」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, wait. We're not done talking--」

name: Ria
message: 「Just. Do. It.♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Waaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「All right, shall we get back to wrapping things up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, sir♪」
We return to the task of summarizing our plans for the Holy Night Festival.
Together, Lolotte and I envision a fun Holy Night Festival.
Lolotte relays those ideas to Amyrina in thorough detail--and, depending on the case, with a bit of exaggeration.
Yet for some reason, Amyrina's reactions are sluggish and uncertain.
From where I'm sitting, it looks like hammering a nail into rice bran.
And yet--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina... could it be that I'm bothering you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you've been looking bored this whole time...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No... that's... well...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I... want you to enjoy yourself too, Amyrina.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to have a wonderful time together with you. So I thought, if it's a Holy Night Festival we can both enjoy...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I'm being a bother, please tell me. I'll stop right away.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「T-That's not...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's not it at all!! I want to be with you too, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's think of ideas together!!」
There is Lolotte, eager to share the joy.
This must be how she draws others in and steadily carves out her own path.
I've carried out our Student Council duties right alongside a Lolotte just like this.

name: Synn
message: 「In that case! Since we've got the chance, let's decide this part based on Amyrina's opinion.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ehhh~~!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a huge responsibility~~\s07」

name: Amyrina
message: 「E-Eek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, don't worry, you'll be fine. We'll take full responsibility, so it's all good.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeh--!? Is that true!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Honestly... you're so reckless, Lolotte...\s10」
I'm sure what Lolotte is doing for Amyrina right now... is what she's been doing for me all this time.
